steps.en: Install the companion and the CLI
Attach a companion process to each simulator or device
steps.zh: 给每台模拟器或设备挂一个 companion 进程

steps.en: Launch an app on a target
steps.zh: 在某个目标上启动一个 app

steps.en: Execute it on the target through the private frameworks and return the result
steps.zh: 通过私有框架在目标上执行，并把结果回传

value.en: Your script addresses simulators and real devices uniformly, from a client that can run off the machine — you own the orchestration.
value.zh: 你的脚本用同一套命令寻址模拟器和真机，客户端还能跑在别的机器上——编排权在你手里。
